text:
elaine: Quick sync from the RFC follow-up: we need a low-friction way to tag long-lived tech debt so it doesn't disappear into PR hell. proposal: lightweight registry + GH label + automated gating.

vik: Agree. Keep it tiny at first. Fields: id, summary, owner, severity, estimated effort, last-updated, rollback-mode.

noah: For rollout, suggest 2 phases: Phase A = registry + label + dashboards; Phase B = enforcement (checks that prevent closing without validation).

maria: Phase A timeline looks doable in 2 wks. Phase B will need product signoff because it can block merges.

sasha: For Phase A, I can wire the GH webhook to create/update registry entries. simple payload example: `{"tranche":"T-123","issue":12345}`.

elaine: Nice. We also need audit logs for each tranche touch so we can see drift and reviewers.

vik: On metrics: propose three signals for 'staleness' and rollback risk: (1) PRs touching tranche >7 days open, (2) service 99.9th latency delta vs baseline, (3) customer incidents attributed. each should be a numeric column in the registry.

noah: How do we ensure teams actually fix vs just closing PRs? maybe require eval harness pass + two reviewers or a post-merge smoke test.

sasha: We can enforce one automated eval (from eval CI) and a human reviewer before a tranche is marked resolved. GH app can gate that status label.

maria: Rollback automation question: who owns the playbooks? My vote: Eng-SRE implements triggers; service teams register fallback variants and safe rollback scripts.

elaine: Agree. Also add an option to 'defer to degrade' for customer-facing model changes (degrade to cheaper/safer variant instead of full rollback).

vik: Migration plan: pick two pilot tranches in serving-runtime and model-router. Run Phase A for 3 weeks, measure dashboard adoption, then enable soft enforcement for new PRs only.

noah: Can we add a slack alert integration for stale tranches? e.g., `#eng-debt-review` weekly digest + oncall pings for >30 day staleness.

sasha: I'll add the cron job. Also adding a small UI in Console for owners to mark 'in-progress' vs 'blocked' so reviewers know status.

maria: Action items: Sasha -> webhook + GH label spike (this week). Vik -> schema doc and sample dashboard queries. Elaine -> pilot tranche list and owner opt-in. Noah -> draft runbook for Phase B gating.

elaine: Can we put a TTL on cold tranches so they get auto-archived after 12mo unless renewed?

vik: TTL ok but archived should be queryable. don't delete.

noah: +1 on not deleting. we need historical context for incident postmortems.

maria: @oncall-bot please schedule a 30m sync next Wednesday 16:00 UTC for pilot kick-off.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m sync in #architecture on 2025-04-09 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

sasha: I'll open the PR tonight with the initial GH app config and label schema.

elaine: Great work. reconvene after spikes and we'll pick dates for Phase B. :rocket:
